soil.title: Soil texture
soil.intro: Tap the triangle or move the sliders to match your soil. The 12 classes are the USDA texture classes.

advice.low: Water moves through slowly. Waterlogging is the usual risk: avoid working it wet, keep residue on top, and use deep-rooted crops in the rotation.
advice.medium: Water moves through at a moderate pace. Keep the surface covered so it does not crust, and keep roots in the ground between crops.
advice.high: Water drains fast and little is stored. Drought is the usual risk: favour drought-tolerant crops, keep residue as mulch, and water little and often if you irrigate.

soil.note: This is general guidance by texture. It does not change your scores: only a soil test (pH, organic matter, texture) can raise confidence.
